none: PAS CAM-5F1BA3: Roman Coin : Incomplete copper-alloy nummus of Constantine II as Caesar, AD317-337
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ [PROVIDENTIAE] CAESS ; D/ [...]STANTINVS IVN NOB C

An incomplete copper-alloy nummus of Constantine II as Caesar, AD317-337. AD324-325, (Reece period 16). Reverse legend reads [PROVIDENTIAE] CAESS. Reverse shows Camp-gate with two turrets. Mint is Trier. See RIC VII, p.205, c.f.455. Obverse shows Laureate bust left. Obverse legend reads [...]STANTINVS IVN NOB C. Reverse fields and exergue read: / //(PTR). Die axis is 6 o'clock, weight is 1.64g,…
